verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a cloud-synced 2FA service with a CLI and a self-hostable server, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question. The evidence never documents one. Self-hosting a local instance (localhost:3003) and offline 'Use without backups' mode are adjacent workarounds, not a vendor-provided sandbox kept separate from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
